summary: The vault_encrypted test checks whether a string is an Ansible Vault encrypted value.
questions: How do I check if a variable is vault-encrypted?
Is there a test for inline vault strings?

answer_card.title: vault_encrypted test
answer_card.answer_md: `value is vault_encrypted` is true if the string is an Ansible Vault (e.g. starts with `$ANSIBLE_VAULT;`).
